scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wudao-org/core build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/providers build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/browser build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/server build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/web build && pnpm --filter wudao-harness build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/slack build && pnpm --filter @wudao-org/evals build
scripts.check: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run check:scripts
